variants.title: Velocity of sound in steel by pulse echo
variants.unknown: the longitudinal velocity and the longitudinal modulus of steel
variants.note: Longitudinal velocity about 5900 m/s and density 7850 kg/m^3 for mild steel (NDT tables, from memory - verify).

variants.title: Velocity of sound in Perspex by pulse echo
variants.unknown: the longitudinal velocity and the longitudinal modulus of Perspex
variants.note: Longitudinal velocity about 2730 m/s and density 1180 kg/m^3 for acrylic; a plastic absorbs ultrasound strongly, so the echoes die away fast (NDT tables, from memory - verify).
